headline: The adapter is not live AI. It is the rulebook for live AI later.
copy: Use this room to test how source packets become answer drafts while every source, confidence, and boundary remains visible.

steps.title: Source
steps.copy: Read only the returned source packet.

steps.title: Compose
steps.copy: Draft a short answer in the approved answer anatomy.

steps.title: Refuse
steps.copy: Use no-source behavior when evidence is missing.

steps.title: Carry
steps.copy: Offer one small, grounded next step.

candidates.title: Steady action answer
candidates.reason: Approved source packet with clear learner use and calm boundary.

record.title: Steady action
record.summary: Supports practical answers about steady action while avoiding promises of guaranteed calm.
record.boundary: Reflection support only; not therapy, ritual instruction, or spiritual command.

candidates.packet:
Adapter draft
Direct answer: Begin with one honest next action, not the result you cannot control.
Source card: Bhagavad Gita 2.48 | Bhagavad Gita | Smriti | High confidence.
Plain meaning: The source supports steadiness in action, not guaranteed peace.
Boundary: Reflection support only.
Carry: Choose one small duty and do it slowly.

candidates.title: Oppenheimer correction
candidates.reason: Approved category correction with a clear overclaim boundary.

record.title: Oppenheimer category correction
record.summary: Supports correcting the common claim: the famous line is associated with the Gita, not the four Vedas.
record.boundary: Do not call it a direct quote from the four Vedas.

candidates.title: No-source refusal

record.title: Modern aircraft overclaim
record.summary: Used to refuse inflated claims when no reviewed source can carry the answer.
record.boundary: Say no reliable source is present; do not invent validation.
